title: A kinetic intra-cellular assay (KICA) to measure quantitative compound binding kinetics within living cells
protocol: Prepare a concentration titration of BSP-590 in 100% DMSO in a white 384-well micromicroplate.
Apply 5 μL of tracer dilution buffer per well.
Apply 5 μL of OptiMEM per well.
Place the plate on a microplate shaker for 15 min at 550 RPM, in the dark.
Wash pre-transfected HEK293 cells with PBS.
Apply 0.5 mL of Trypsin solution per well and incubate for 4 min.
Suspend and combine the cells by adding 2 mL of supplemented DMEM per well.
Transfer cells to a 50 mL falcon tube.
Spin the cells at 125 g for 5 min in a centrifuge.
Resuspend the resulting cell pellet in an equivalent volume of OptiMEM (2.5 mL per well).
Count the cells and adjust the concentration to 2.5 × 10^5 cells/mL.
Add NanoGlo Substrate (Furimizine) to the cells at a 1 in 500 final concentration.
Mix by inversion.
Incubate for 2 min.
Seed 40 μL of the cell suspension to each well of the pre-prepared white 384-well microplate containing the BSP-590 titration.
Initiate repetitive readings of luminescence and fluorescence for at least one hour using a microplate reader equipped with 450 ± 20 nm bandpass and 610 nm longpass filters.
Measure the exact time between adding cells to the BSP-590 and starting reads.
Prepare a concentration titration of competitor compounds in a 384-well white microplate in 100% DMSO.
Normalize total DMSO volume across wells.
Include control columns of fully inhibited tracer binding (e.g., 7 μM JQ1) on each test microplate.
Include uninhibited tracer binding controls (DMSO alone) on each test microplate.
Apply 5 μl of tracer dilution buffer per well containing 1.5 μM BSP-590 (10 times the previously determined KD, app).
Add 5 μL of OptiMEM to each well and place the microplate on a shaker at 550 RPM for 15 min in the dark.
Wash pre-transfected HEK293 cells with PBS, apply 0.5 mL per well of Trypsin solution and incubate for 4 min.
Suspend and combine the cells by adding 2 mL per well of supplemented DMEM.
Transfer to a 50 mL falcon tube and spin the cells down at 125 g for 5 min in a centrifuge.
Resuspend the cell pellet in an equivalent volume of OptiMEM (2.5 mL per well of the 6 well microplate).
Count the cells and adjust the concentration to 2.5 × 10^5 cells/mL.
Add NanoGlo Substrate (Furimizine) to the cells at a 1 in 500 final concentration, mix by inversion and incubate for 2 min.
Seed 40 μL of the cell suspension to each well of the pre-prepared white 384-well microplate containing the competitor titration.
Initiate repetitive readings of luminescence and fluorescence for at least 2 h using a microplate reader equipped with 450 ± 20 nm bandpass and 610 nm longpass filters.
